snippet.title: Tiny Brutalism — Eco Update
snippet.description:
Tiny Brutalism - A cozy little sandbox for making not-so-cozy architecture.

PLAY IT HERE: https://placeholders.itch.io/tiny-brutalism

a relaxing freeform building game inspired by brutalist architecture.
Create strange monuments, impossible structures, concrete towers, or just a really big wall.
There’s no goal and no right way to build. Just make whatever you feel like making.

Just you, an empty space, and an unreasonable amount of concrete.

#indiegame  #gamedev  #brutalism  #tinyglade
